pieces.Text: Numerous Harrow readings early in your life seem to have hit the mark precisely, increasing your belief that you are destined for a specific purpose in life. You get a +1 bonus on all Will saves made to resist enchantment effects. 1/day, you may draw a card from a Harrow deck you own. At any one time for the rest of that day, you may apply a +2 bonus on any d20 roll modified by the card's suit. You may assign this +2 bonus after you make the roll, but you must do so before you know whether the roll was a success or not.
